purpose: Responsive media renderer for backend-provided asset variants.
ownedConcepts: Silent customer fallback for failed image loads
businessRules: Do not construct or version image URLs in the frontend when the backend has already supplied variant URLs.
Prefer AVIF, then WebP, then original-compatible fallback formats.
Preserve backend dimensions and alt text for layout stability and accessibility.
Use eager loading only for above-the-fold media; keep other media lazy.
Render a branded fallback surface when backend merchandising references an archived or missing media asset.
Customer-facing image failures must not show upload/debug errors; explicit broken image warnings belong to admin asset management.

For backend-static-dev media, prefer the original backend static URL because generated /shresta-media/variants paths may not exist in local development; S3/CDN delivery modes should continue using optimized variants.
If a selected variant fails in customer UI, retry the backend-provided original asset URL before rendering the branded SHRESTA fallback.
The picture wrapper applies stable block/full-size classes for fixed aspect-ratio containers so image layout does not create blank customer-facing space.
